subject: Important Update: New Payment Options Available
body: Dear valued customers, we are pleased to announce that we have introduced new payment options to make your shopping experience more convenient. You can now pay using credit/debit cards, PayPal, or bank transfers. This change is in response to your feedback and our commitment to enhancing customer satisfaction. We hope you find these new options helpful. Thank you for choosing our services. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to our customer support team.
